summary: Backend-only regression for the 50 Personal Growth starter-activities addition. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_social_seed.py with two new cases (PG title uniqueness, PG duration coverage {5,10,20,30} within allowed {5,10,15,20,30,45,60}). Verified: auth flow (register/login/auth/me), fresh-user total=508 with exact per-category distribution (Creativity=51, Learning=51, Coding / Building=51, Reading=51, Wellness=51, Movement=51, Brain Gym=51, Social=50, Everyday Life=51, Personal Growth=50), Social still 50 unique + 4-bucket coverage, Personal Growth 50 unique + 4-bucket coverage, idempotent re-login (no reseed), persistent-account not reseeded, GET /api/activities >200 (to_list(2000)), custom activity POST persists, favorite PATCH toggles. All 13 pytest cases passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 932 lines (up from 833) - well past the 700-line split threshold. STARTER_ACTIVITIES (~500+ lines of pure data across 10 categories) should be extracted into /app/backend/starter_activities.py to keep server.py focused on routing/logic.

GET /api/activities .to_list(2000) hard cap unchanged - with 508 seeded rows per user + customs, a heavy user could approach this. Consider server-side pagination or per-category filtering before that becomes a real issue.
seed_user() default-favorites logic still hard-codes {'Reading','Wellness'} - as user categories grow (now 10), consider making auto-favorite behavior configurable or removing it.
test_credentials: Existing: littlewhile.test@example.com / LittleWhile123! (used for existing-user non-reseed check). Fresh accounts generated per run with pattern test-social-<ts>-<rand>@example.com / TestPass123!.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers one fresh account (508 seeded activities) and creates one custom activity (TEST_custom_activity) under that account. No cleanup performed; fresh emails per run avoid collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_social_seed.py is the authoritative regression for starter-activity content across all 10 categories. EXPECTED_COUNTS at top of file is the single source of truth - update it if STARTER_ACTIVITIES changes. Personal Growth tests mirror Social tests structurally; add analogous test pairs for any future new category.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. 50 Personal Growth activities added correctly: category string exact match, 50 unique titles, duration coverage includes required buckets (5,10,20,30) and stays within allowed set, total 508 activities seeded on fresh registration, idempotency preserved.
